terms.grammar: adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)
terms.comment: The tenth month, counting from March, and the month of the Saturnalia. Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Decembrēs: the 1st, 5th and 13th; the 31st is prīdiē Kalendās Jānuāriās.

phrases.latin: December est mēnsis: cum maximē cīvitās sūdat
phrases.english: it is December: the city is sweating at its hardest (getting ready for the Saturnalia)

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 77, 301.
Seneca from the Latinitas loci collections.
